models.label: Kimi (open weights)
models.description: Single model on one logical GPU (sum of donor VRAM). Not loaded until the pool hits the load milestone. Service goes live after weights load on the mesh.

milestones.title: First light
milestones.description: At least one donor is online. The logical device exists.

milestones.title: Cluster formed
milestones.description: Multiple machines contribute. Pool is a real multi-backend device.

milestones.title: Kimi eligible
milestones.description: Aggregate VRAM and backend count meet the Kimi load gate. Agents arm weight cache.

milestones.title: Weights published
milestones.description: Open checkpoint URLs and hashes are pinned in the manifest.

milestones.title: Model loaded
milestones.description: Weights are resident on the mesh (loaded into the logical device).

milestones.title: Service live
milestones.description: Public API serves real Kimi completions from the joule supercomputer.

weights.note: Pin redistributable open Kimi checkpoint URLs/hashes when the pool routinely exceeds kimi-eligible. Until then agents arm the cache only.
